strings.gate.lead: 在沙特阿拉伯东部省，沙下藏水，山中洞穴密布，集市世代相传。向下滑动，开启这段故事。
strings.tip.family: 为当天行程就近添一处家庭公园：贾瓦塔清真寺旁边的贾瓦塔公园；适合散步和出游的阿卜杜拉国王环境公园。
strings.tip.familyCoast: 去海岸的那天，再添上乌盖尔海滩。
strings.att.qaisariyah.summary: 可上溯 200 多年的老集市，是最古老的传统集市之一，也是寻访手工艺与本地物产的去处。
strings.att.najm-park.summary: 一座环绕历史悠久的艾因奈杰姆泉而建的公园；这眼泉位于穆巴拉兹以西，是哈萨最负盛名的硫磺疗养泉。

notes: [s1] gate.lead: only change is the leading location 在沙特阿拉伯东部省，(东部省 = termbase 'Eastern Province'; 沙特阿拉伯 as in published al-uqair summary_zh). Rest of the approved sentence kept verbatim.
[s1] tip.family: dropped the coast clause；去海岸的那天，还有乌盖尔海滩 and closed the list with 。 — the two approved park clauses kept verbatim (贾瓦塔公园, 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园 per ref.json).
[s1] tip.familyCoast: appended directly after tip.family; verb 添 mirrors tip.family's 添一处; 乌盖尔海滩 is the termbase/published form.

[s1] att.qaisariyah.summary: (1) 海湾地区 removed (not in en/ar); (2) broken subject of 挑选 replaced by 也是寻访……的去处 (= ar «وجهة»), keeping the approved phrase 手工艺与本地物产; (3) 市集 unified to 集市. NUMBER: ctx asks for «200 多年» but pack.json gives no digit in en/ar and no allowNums, so verify-stage's number fence rejects 200; rendered «أكثر من قرنين» as 两个多世纪 (same meaning, no new digit). If the coordinator adds allowNums ["200"], swap back to 可上溯 200 多年 to match body_zh and the home badge «200 多年历史».

[s1] att.najm-park.summary: no longer opens with the park name; rebuilt on the Arabic order (منتزه حول عين النجم التاريخية غربي المبرز، أشهر…), keeping 穆巴拉兹 · 艾因奈杰姆泉 · 硫磺疗养泉 and the approved clause 这眼泉……是哈萨最负盛名的硫磺疗养泉.
[s2] att.qaisariyah.summary: added 是 so the summary reads 是……之一，也是……的去处 (parallel predicates) instead of a bare appositive; no fact or name change.
[s2] gate.lead / tip.family / tip.familyCoast / att.najm-park.summary: read as native copy; no change. Approved wording outside the defects untouched.

[s3] Localization pass: no glosses needed (东部省 is the standard mainland form; 乌盖尔海滩 / 贾瓦塔公园 / 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园 / 艾因奈杰姆泉 already established on the site). No photo/advice/quality claims added; religious and heritage references unchanged. Strings identical to stage 2.
[s3] Open point for coordinator: att.qaisariyah.summary uses 两个多世纪 only because the number fence has no allowNums for 200; the site-consistent form is 可上溯 200 多年.
[s4] att.qaisariyah.summary: CROSS ح1 applied — 两个多世纪 → 可上溯 200 多年 (allowNums 200 now in pack.json; matches body_zh «可上溯 200 多年» and home badge «200 多年历史»).

[s4] Fact fence: no additions in any of the 5 strings vs en + ar. 海湾地区 stays removed. «من أعرق الأسواق الشعبية / one of the oldest folk markets» kept as 最古老的传统集市之一: the published Qaisariyah body_zh («最古老、最有故事的传统市集之一») and FAQ («海湾地区最古老的传统集市之一») both use 传统 for this exact claim; 民俗市集 in termbase is a facility-name term (Mushaqar park souq, 妇女民俗市集), not a descriptor for this claim. Switching to 民间/民俗 would split the summary from its own page body; no fact change either way, so the approved 传统 stays (amend rule: fix the defect only).

[s4] gate.lead: 东部省 = termbase entry «Eastern Province» and the only form in published bodies (palm-village, umzurainiq: 东部省省长…; 东部省清真寺建筑). Comma after 在沙特阿拉伯东部省 kept: a 在… locative followed by a colon is unidiomatic in Chinese; the comma lets the place frame all three clauses, which is what the Arabic colon does.
[s4] najm-park / tip.family / tip.familyCoast: published names verbatim (艾因奈杰姆泉, 穆巴拉兹, 贾瓦塔公园, 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园, 乌盖尔海滩); no 翻译腔; unchanged.
[s5] Proofread: no changes. All five strings clean on punctuation, spacing, names, numbers and grammar.
